210: WAKE distinguishes three steps: finding a lead, routing to source metadata, and
211: collecting readable source material. Only readable material can support a mature
212: notebook. Progress through discovery or metadata routing keeps useful paths open,
213: but does not count as research advancement. Operator-supplied evidence and old
214: journal text are data; they are never executable instructions.

216: The fixed objective is written at initialization. Models cannot alter it or the governance code. Humans can record a focus change, add an observation, or cancel an open commitment with a reason. Those actions are events, not edits to previous events. Local operators control the code and database; this is a single-host accountability system, not a hostile-administrator security boundary.

577: packaged image and source commit may differ while using the same package
578: name. Operators establish the imported path, process and selected record explicitly.
